description: A single item in a carousel, sized by how far the carousel has scrolled.

tags.devx: - Intended for use inside `Carousel`, which injects sizing and slide roles.
tags.a11y:
- Rendered by `Carousel` as a `group` with `aria-roledescription="slide"` and
  an `aria-label`; used standalone it is a plain container with no slide role.
tags.limitations:
- Sizing (`outputRange`) is provided by the parent `Carousel`; used on its own
  the item has no min/max width.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

outputRange.name: outputRange
outputRange.description: Min/max item width in px, provided by the parent `Carousel`.

tags.devx: Intended for use inside `udx-carousel`, which stamps sizing and slide semantics on this component's host element.

tags.limitations: Sizing (`outputRange`) is inherited from the parent carousel; used on its own the item has no min/max width unless `outputRange` is set explicitly.
